### A Prayer to Find Eternal Meaning
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-find-eternal-meaning.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 1:9
Points:
- Constant busyness and never-ending daily chores often leave people exhausted and overwhelmed.
- Society tempts us to define our worth by material achievements and relentless striving.
- The repetition of everyday routines reminds us that the world's weight does not rest on our shoulders.
- An unfinished to-do list is not personal failure, as daily duties will always recur.
- Shifting to an eternal perspective allows us to work for the Lord rather than for temporary gains.

### A Dose of Reality
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-5-2025.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 1:2
Points:
- The brevity of human life naturally compels people to ponder whether this world is all there is.
- Ecclesiastes dispels comfortable illusions by presenting the relentless drudgery and repetition of earthly labor.
- Excluding God from the equation leaves life genuinely meaningless and dispiriting.
- Eternal hope in Jesus Christ provides lasting significance beyond the grave and redeems daily life with joy.
